GMCOMBAT.Settings.OpenNpcSheet.Name: Open statblock on an enemy turn
GMCOMBAT.Settings.OpenNpcSheet.Hint: Automatically opens the active enemy's regular D&D5e actor sheet.
Closes the previously auto-opened enemy sheet when the turn changes.
GMCOMBAT.Settings.SelectActiveNpcToken.H: Selects the active enemy token without moving the map.
GMCOMBAT.Settings.PanToActiveNpc.Name: Pan to the active enemy
GMCOMBAT.Settings.PanToActiveNpc.Hint: Moves the map view when an enemy turn begins.
GMCOMBAT.Settings.HiddenMovement.Name: Track hidden movement
GMCOMBAT.Settings.HiddenMovement.Hint: Shows the movement path of the active hidden enemy.
